```plato
//==
// # Device-independent color models
//
// Colors expressed in spaces that do not depend on any particular device: the
// CIE tristimulus hub (`ColorXYZ`) that conversions pass through, its xyY
// factoring, and the perceptual (uniform-ish) spaces built on top of it —
// CIELAB, CIELUV, and OkLab, each with a cylindrical lightness/chroma/hue
// form. The spaces themselves are defined in `color-spaces`.

//==
// ## Device-independent color types

// A color as CIE 1931 XYZ tristimulus values; the device-independent hub
// through which color space conversions pass. Y is luminance.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/CIE_1931_color_space)
type ColorXYZ
    implements INumerical
{
    X: Number;
    Y: Number;
    Z: Number;
}
```
